title: Cheap windows
hint: The hub works out when the price is low and says so: in the notification, in the event log and over MQTT (rbgrid/<mac>/price). It switches nothing itself; automations act on it.
descThreshold: On at {on} or less, off again at {off} or more
deleteBody: Automations that follow it stop getting its on/off.
name: Name
kind_cheapest: Cheapest periods in a time span
kindHint_cheapest: For a load that can run any time in a span, such as a water heater: the cheapest periods of that span each day.
kindHint_deadline: For a load that must be done by a time, such as an EV by 07:00: the cheapest periods of the 24 hours before it.
kindHint_threshold: On whenever the buy price is at or below a level; off again when it rises to a second level (so it doesn't flicker).
toHHint: Earlier than «From» crosses midnight; the same = 24 h
consecutiveHint: The cheapest run of periods in a row, for a load that shouldn't stop and start.
errNameLong: The name is too long for the hub: up to {n} bytes (a Cyrillic letter takes 2).
errHysteresis: The «off» level can't be below the «on» level.
saveFailed: The hub didn't save the windows: {why}
signalHint: Marks in the hub's price notification for automations, such as a diverter that heats water on cheap power.
buyCheapHint: Set when the buy price is below this.
sellLowHint: Set when the sell price is below this, a sign to use the energy rather than export it.
